sourceContext.originPage: NZMP category-landing page (Global Ingredients Network) - 'Learn more About NZMP' teaser grid

contentPattern.structure: large landscape photo + title + short description per card; the whole card links to the target page with a 'Learn more' affordance

suitableFor: promotional teaser-card grids (large photo + title + short description) where the whole card is a link
'learn more about' / 'explore' 2x2 or multi-up static card grids on a light background
cross-links to key destination pages with a lifestyle photo per card
notSuitableFor: navigational cards with a small circular icon + explicit Learn more button (use cards-category)
rotating horizontal teaser carousels with category tag + headline (use carousel-news)
